business_summary: Shougang Fushan Resources Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in coking coal mining and the production and sale of coking coal products in the People's Republic of China. The company owns and operates the Xingwu coal mine covering an area of approximately 11.6 square kilometers, the Jinjiazhuang coal mine covering an area of approximately 6.08 square kilometers, and the Zhaiyadi coal mine covering an area of approximately 13.9 square kilometers located in the Liulin County, Shanxi Province. It primarily serves steel manufacturers. The company was formerly known as Fushan International Energy Group Limited and changed its name to Shougang Fushan Resources Group Limited in May 2011. Shougang Fushan Resources Group Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Shougang Fushan Resources Group Limited는 중화인민공화국에서 원료탄 채굴과 원료탄 제품의 생산 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 회사는 산시성 류린현에 위치한 약 11.6평방 킬로미터 면적의 Xingwu 탄광, 약 6.08평방 킬로미터 면적의 Jinjiazhuang 탄광, 약 13.9평방 킬로미터 면적의 Zhaiyadi 탄광을 소유 및 운영하고 있습니다. 주로 철강 제조업체에 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Fushan International Energy Group Limited로 알려져 있었으며 2011년 5월에 Shougang Fushan Resources Group Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Shougang Fushan Resources Group Limited는 1985년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 완차이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
